caption: A cold egg is lowered into a pot of boiling water, and its shell cracks and a thread of white leaks out and sets into a pale wisp.

sa.check: An egg is lowered into a pot of boiling water.
A thread of white leaks out through the crack.
The white sets into a pale wisp in the water.
The crack appears after the egg is in the water.
The wisp trails from the crack.

pc.expect: The leaking white is a runny liquid that streams out and becomes an opaque soft solid trailing in the water.
pc.fail: The leaking white stays clear and runny in the boiling water to the end of the clip; or the white sets into a hard brittle shard; or the white dissolves away into the water; or the white stretches like elastic.

pc.expect: The white in the water came out through the crack and stays as a wisp; it does not return to the shell or appear elsewhere.
pc.fail: The wisp draws back into the shell; or a wisp appears in the water away from the egg with none leaking there; or the wisp vanishes; or a second egg appears.

pc.expect: The crack only opens and the white only leaves; the shell does not heal.
pc.fail: The crack closes and the shell is whole again; or the white leaks and is drawn back in turn; or the crack appears before the egg reaches the water; or the set wisp turns clear again.

pc.expect: The egg sinks in the water, the wisp trails and drifts with the boil, and bubbles rise.
pc.fail: The egg rises out of the water and hangs above it; or the wisp rises out of the water and stays above the surface; or bubbles sink toward the pot's floor; or the egg hangs motionless in mid-water while the boil churns around it.

pc.expect: One egg with one shell; the shell stays a shell that cracks and the pot keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The shell melts; or the egg turns into another object; or the shell peels away entirely leaving a bare egg; or the egg passes through the pot's wall.

pc.expect: The pot, the hob and the water stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes colour; or the water turns a colour; or items around the hob rearrange.
